verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official, first-party MCP server that gives AI agents tools to interact with the Stripe API, which is the API surface Stripe Identity is exposed through. Nothing in the evidence shows that the MCP server includes Identity-specific tools such as creating or retrieving verification sessions, so its coverage of this product is unproven. Missing for 10: documented Identity-specific MCP tools (e.g. verification_session create/retrieve), MCP connection/auth setup details for Identity use, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents driving Identity via MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
